meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图提取商家线索和联系方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从谷歌地图批量获取商家信息用于销售或市场分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract business leads and contact details from Google Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch collect business info from Google Maps for sales or market analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你从 Google 地图上批量提取商家信息，包括名称、电话、网站、评分、评论等，并以表格形式展示结果。
howto.when: 当你要求查找某类商家（如“找柏林牙医”）或说“抓取 Google 地图”时触发。需要电脑已安装 Docker。

say.note: Claude 会开始抓取并展示结果表格。

say.text: 抓取纽约的咖啡店，深度浅层
say.note: Claude 会按浅层深度（约20条）抓取。

say.text: 把刚才的结果保存到桌面
say.note: Claude 会询问保存位置并复制文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract business info (name, phone, website, rating, reviews, etc.) from Google Maps and display results in a table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find businesses (e.g., "find dentists in Berlin") or say "scrape Google Maps". Requires Docker installed.

say_en.note: Claude will start scraping and show results.

say_en.text: Scrape coffee shops in New York, shallow depth.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape with shallow depth (~20 results).

say_en.text: Save the results to my desktop.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for location and copy the file.
